duty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: INC-2026-0421 - elevated error-rate + routing anomalies in eu-west-1. Impact: hosted inference 500s, partial truncation for longer sequences. Paging on-call.
Maya: Ack. I'm on it. grabbing logs + routing traces. ETA 10m.
Ethan: On standby. quick Q: do we have any recent routing-policy or model-tag rollouts in eu regions in the last 4h?
Maya: Checking. I see a policy push at +3h: `route-priority-adjust v2 -> enable_spillover=true` (deployed 1933331200). Also a model rollout flagged `model-v1-legacy-8bit` staged to fallback pool at 1933332000.
Maya: Telemetry: big spike in reqs hitting eu-west-1 frontends at 1933333005, followed by a sharp rise in 'route_mismatch' logs and then 500s. Looks like fallback decision picked an incompatible quantized variant.
Ethan: Hmm. can you paste a raw log sample? need exact route_decision chain.
Maya: paste below:
```
[1933333010] route_decision: incoming=hosted.text.generate region=eu-west-1 preferred_model=model-v2-16b
[1933333010] capacity_check: eu-west-1 saturated -> spillover=true
[1933333010] fallback_selector: candidate_list=[model-v1-legacy-8bit, model-v2-quant, model-v1-8bit-safe]
[1933333010] fallback_choice: model-v1-legacy-8bit (tag=legacy,quantized=true,compatible=false)
[1933333011] inference_error: model-incompatibility: tokenizer-mismatch -> 500
```
Maya: That tokenizer-mismatch line is the one producing truncated/500 responses.
route-bot: Auto-action triggered: applying emergency route override to prefer eu-central-1 healthy pool. command: `route override add region eu-west-1 -> primary eu-central-1 until 1933334020` (applied 1933333099)
Ethan: I rolled a manual quick-fix: removed model-v1-legacy-8bit from fallback set for hosted traffic in eu regions. Command: `routing:set-fallbacks hosted remove model-v1-legacy-8bit` (1933333155)
Priya: Noted. can we get a count of impacted customers? Carol, FYI on customer impact.
Carol: Customer impact: 4 paying customers reported degraded responses (2 truncated, 2 timeouts) between 1933333010-1933333180. No billing spikes. CS already opened support tickets TTL-778, TTL-779.
Maya: Timeline so far:
- 1933331200: routing policy change (enable_spillover=true)
- 1933332000: model rollout tag changes - model-v1-legacy-8bit added to fallback pool
- 1933333005: traffic spike into eu-west-1
- 1933333010: fallback selected model-v1-legacy-8bit -> tokenizer mismatch -> 500s
- 1933333099: route-bot override to eu-central-1
- 1933333155: manual removal of legacy model from fallback set
- 1933333200: error rates decline to baseline
Ethan: Hypotheses:
1) rollout + spillover interaction: enable_spillover caused selector to widen candidate list; legacy model lacked compatibility tag, selector still chose it because of older priority scoring.
2) tagging regression: model metadata lost `compatible:true` during the model rollout event (1933332000) -> selector couldn't filter.
3) capacity mis-estimation: load driven spillover produced rapid decision in a narrow time window and selector used last-known priority (race) -> bad candidate.
Maya: Evidence supporting hypothesis 1: we have multiple routing_events showing candidate_list growth exactly after the policy push at 1933331200. Also deployment logs show fallback pool membership update at 1933332000.
Ethan: Quick queries I ran:
`SELECT count(*) FROM routing_events WHERE ts BETWEEN 1933333000 AND 1933333200 AND region='eu-west-1' AND event='fallback_choice';`
-> 372 fallback_choice decisions in 2 minutes
`SELECT distinct(candidate) FROM fallback_logs WHERE ts > 1933332000 AND region LIKE 'eu-%';`
-> model-v1-legacy-8bit, model-v2-quant, model-v1-8bit-safe
Maya: Logs uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-0421/raw-routing-1933333.tar.gz (contains per-request traces + tokenizer mismatch stack)
sre-ops: grabbing JVM/serving traces from eu-west-1 hosts, pushing flamegraphs to same bucket.

Ethan: Quick mitigation checklist:
- revert enable_spillover flag for hosted traffic in eu regions (temp)
- enforce compatibility tag check in selector (blocklist if missing)
- add metric alert for fallback_choice -> incompatible_model events
Maya: I'm going to put a short-lived handoff: Priya, can you carry the overnight watch and own follow-ups (RCA doc, postmortem timeline, model metadata audit)?
Priya: Ack, taking handoff. I'll start with a model metadata sweep and a small repro harness to simulate tokenizer mismatch. Will update by 1933334500.
